# TerraSpace

> TerraSpace is an on-demand workspace reservation platform with real-time slot scheduling, Google Calendar synchronization, and PayBridge-hosted checkout (Xendit and Midtrans).

## Payment Provider (PayBridge)

- Sandbox Base URL: https://paybridge-sandbox.ardial.my.id
- Production Base URL: https://paybridge.ardial.my.id
- PayBridge Documentation: https://paybridge.ardial.my.id/docs/integration.md
- PayBridge LLM Guide: https://paybridge.ardial.my.id/llms.txt
- Platform Signing Key (Sandbox): https://paybridge-sandbox.ardial.my.id/.well-known/paybridge-signing-key.json
- Platform Signing Key (Production): https://paybridge.ardial.my.id/.well-known/paybridge-signing-key.json

## Webhooks

- PayBridge Callback Endpoint: POST /webhooks/paybridge
- Registered Callback URL: https://animator-ageless-moonstone.ngrok-free.dev/webhooks/paybridge
- Handled Events: payment_succeeded, payment_failed, payment_expired, subscription_cycle_succeeded, subscription_cycle_failed, subscription_cycle_retrying
- Authentication: Ed25519 request signature verified against PayBridge platform public key
